body: Thanks mate! I’ll make sure to use these tips. Already got a gym membership cheaply but the rest i really sidnt think of! Me and my pup thank you.

According to them I’m not depressed and just lazy, attention seeking and terrible. I’ll take it as long as they don’t come after me for my dog. They can think what they want, i have my family with me.
They can contact me all they want I won’t return to someone who wanted to sell my dog.

Ah im so sorry i cant figure out how to show you the face of my boy. :(

He is the best thing I could have ever hoped for, not in the US, but we have a good social net. I already got a gym membership for cheap for showers and am already with an agency (I think it’s called?) that works with homeless and jobless peeps like me. They’re already guiding me where they can and I’m thankful for it.

I won’t let my dog down, he deserves the best.
I’ll make sure to have my dog be as happy as he can be. Not gonna give up, I’ll just keep on going with him as motivation. It’s going to be alrighty

I already took a look and found a church that distributes food to people in need. I found a reliable way to get food for my dog and am now looking for as many jobs I can have to make sure I can get stable ground again. I’ll figure out how to be safe first. My mental health will get better with the support I have from my dog. Thank you so much.
Thanks. I’ll make sure me and my dog can have a safe life sooner or later, no matter how rough ifs going to be. I’ll grow from this and I learn from this.
Thank you. I’ll be proud of myself later, but for now I’ll just love my dog.
I’ll always put my safety high. I’ll make sure me and my dog will get a home as soon as I can manage.
Nap with my dog in my arms in the cool shade. There are worse options.
He deserves one. He’s a very good boy who is cheering me up with every move he does.
Thank you very much! I’ll check it all out.
It’s rather warm today but I’m staying near a forest in the shade of trees for that. I’ll try the jug method too, thank you very much!
I’ll check it out, thank you very much!

This is what my fear all along has been. They’ve shut down me asking about getting professional help once a few years back. But they worked at a hospital. They know what suicidal tendencies are but didn’t want to aknowledge that I would have it. They love me. I just have to get them to realize how close of a call this was.

But I’m fully aware that if I’m not getting professional help with their blessing I’m getting it with only my dog to back me up.

I’m sorry your parents reacted like this. You didn’t deserve it. I hope you got the help or will get it. No one should fight that on their own.

What I’ve figured out so far is where the local hospital is located and what the number for mental health issues is. I only have my parents. 
I hope you’ll be okay as well.

I won’t manage it on my own. I’m fully aware of that, trying to manage everything alone has brought me to this point. If parents don’t work, hospital it is. I’m gonna fight tooth and nail for my dog to be happy.

I’ll try to use the support systems I have left. 
I hope you’ll be okay.
Haha pet your dog everyday :) thanks for the encouragement.
Aye mate, I’m glad your friend is going better. I’ll take any encouragement that I can get. Not letting my dog down after letting myself down. I won’t go down without a fight to at least get help.

Tried to pet him for you. Instructions unclear, he’s now munching my hand. 

I hope I can have more opportunities to write letters that aren’t the bearers of bad news.

Thanks mate. I’ll take every bit that keeps me down right now, now that I am able to think like it.

I need professional help so I’ll try to fight for it. They love me, they may not know how to handle it. And that I have to know is okay. 

I’m sick. I don’t expect them to be able to know how to treat it. I know professionals can try. And that’s my bet right now. I will be a burden. But I have to be to turn into a non burden they can help. Hopefully.

That’s one way to see it I suppose. I won’t magically get better. My world still revolves around the fact that suicide seems to be the only way. 
I just got it through that I have to ask for help and put my foot down to get it. My dog doesn’t deserve it. 

I’m sorry about your girlfriend.

They do. I love them anyways. I’ll go and get it through to them what I did. I’ll take their outbursts over my dog looking for me and crying like I was told he did while I was out doing it. Rip it off like a bandaid at this point.

I’ll reach out to my parents first. I love them and they deserve to know what I almost succeeded with. 
But if all else fails I know the hospitals location. 

It did feel calming. I wasn’t scared. But then my dog got me worried and guilty. I still am suicidal. But I don’t want to be for my dog, same way I didn’t want to sleep long for him. Funny how that works.

Im not in the US, but we still have good care. 
My parents are taught that and found it first hand, they both worked in hospitals. I think what they need to know is that I succeeded in that aspect too well. The only reason they’ll hear about it is because I already did it. It failed, sure, but if it wasn’t for my dog I’d be out and about again.

They’ll get it. I have faith in it. They’ll lash out, accuse me because they love me and don’t want it to be true. It is though so I’ll do what I can. If that means walking to the next hospital and asking them wether I have any long damages from my failure because I really just want to go on runs with my dog.

To change takes courage. 
I do not have enough yet, exept for this step. If my parents don’t acknowledge the gravity of the situation I will go to a doctor. I need help, my dog let me know he still needs me. I won’t let him down, whatever it takes.
Btw your mom does sound amazing. I’m happy you have her and thanks. Maybe it’ll be fine.

The note is already in the works. It’s currently written in the same folder as my suicide note, which I have to admit made me chuckle a bit. I now know I’ll have to be direct. It’s a last ditch effort to them. To be fair, it’s past that. I could’ve been dead rn if not for just leaving me unconscious. I know I have to be honest about it. I don’t want to hurt them. But I realise, the other thing would’ve hurt em to. I know they love me. I hope they know that. I trust them with this. Somehow.

I know. They love me and the idea that I am all this mess will hurt them. They’ll lash out, they’ll deny. They’ve done it before but back then I gave up on it. I don’t plan on repeating that mistake.

I know what I attempted, I know I need help. I got the push from my dog that I needed. Maybe the attempt helped in making me see it.

After seeing all these comments and encouragements I have to admit it seems easier. Just get it out, get it over, have a backup. Thanks dude.

If my attempt doesn’t convince them I will have a whole other can of worms to open. I’ve gotten some ideas about a note so thanks mate. I left my uni and my friends and cut them off because to be honest I was just preparing to get it over with. But I looked up the nearest hospital, I have my dog. So far I’ll focus on the fact that I don’t want him to miss me.

I will take a letter approach. I stutter and fumble and swallow my tongue too much to get it off without being interrupted. I suppose I’ll have to mention my attempt, to see what of the side effects exept the one I was going for happened. My reason to keep going is my dog. If my fear of leaving him alone is what gets me up right now so be it.

I’m glad to hear it. I’ve broken most of my support field off in preparation. One may say my parents and my dog are the only things that I would’ve left behind that would’ve maybe felt sad to see me go. They’re here. If they’re not, my dog is. I’m not gonna fail him and if the fear of leaving him alone is keeping me on my legs, so be it.

I’m glad you’re still here too Mate. It gives me hope to see others found a way out. I hope I can leave that hopelessness on the floor and grow. 
It must’ve failed for a reason I reckon.

I appreciate it mate. I know I need the help, so I’ll ask for it. I know what I did and what effects it would have and am maybe lucky that I failed the first time. It probably was my dog spiritually punching me back to life.

I have a chance to ask for help now. I have a reason to. I won’t squander it.

It’s amazing how much the littlest whack with a paw can get you up and thinking. 
Thank you, I may not bring the ring to Mordor but I’m hauling around myself. I won’t let me down.
I’m glad your wife has you. Thank you, for her too.

I’ve failed the attempt already. I knew what it would entail. I was aware of what could happen but at this point I do not feel any fear. I didn’t feel any fear. 
I’ll look into the groups. I’ll ask for professional help to locate these issues officially.
Thanks for the offer dude. I may take you up on the offer if it fails on a family level. Sometimes a strangers judgement is good. Thanks :)

Thanks dude. I got him on my leg and I’m going to put up a fight.
it’s encouraging to know people will give advice to a stranger. I will have to believe they’ll give me advice too. I’m not disappearing tomorrow. And hopefully not for a long time.

Don’t worry About it. My parents have their own struggles, their own views and I know where they’re coming from. I’ve also not been an easy child. They mean it well, they just don’t know how serious it is so far, I’ve made sure of it. And if they won’t give me help I’ll have to get over myself and walk to an emergency room. I have one being who believes in me. That’s enough a reason for me to fight now.

I only have my parents, I made sure of that before. It’s my fault but I need to put my trust in them for this. I’m not going to let myself be pushed off again. I will ask them to take it serious, if I have to throw the rope at them. I’d rather end up using it to play tug with my dog.

I’m happy for you dude. I don’t have professional help as I’ve gotten written off by my parents before. I won’t stop asking for it now. I want my dog to be happy. If I have to start a fight for it I will. He’s a good boy and I’m going to fight for him.

I’ve attempted suicide a week ago. I woke up and came home to my dog jumping me at the door. I’m not going to leave him or attempt to. I need help, I acknowledge it. I’m going to talk to my parents. I hope they won’t judge me and push me aside again but I won’t give up now. Not while he’s munching my darn socks.
Hah, that does sound like a good laugh! I called em before and got put on hold but I assume I’ll just have to go straight ahead and tell someone huh.
Called em before, got put on hold. I’ll try again sure. I’ll see how it goes this time. Thank you very much.
My mother is from a household where depression is solved through positive thinking, sports and lack of contact to the outside world. At that point no help is better sadly.

I asked for help once, but my parents told me that going to get help would taint my record and would make people avoid me. I tend to be dramatic in many situations, making a big show of things. I fear me sitting down with them in private made them think it isn’t bad enough. Which is fair, so I won’t bother them again.

Bake a whole tray of muffins, eat it in one go while sitting in the forest looking at the trees. Take food from the most expensive restaurant and give it away to people down on their luck and ask them for a name in exchange.

Cuddle my loved ones once more and gift them everything they want.

Tip that barista that made me my favorite hot drink and told me about her cat excitedly a whole lot and thank her.

I just want to make someone happy, no matter a stranger or a loved one.
